title: Baba Lysaga — Three Offerings
summary: Mixed-type grave offerings feed Baba Lysaga for cards, life, and a telegraphed drain, with land recursion as the backup.

tags.name: sacrifice
tags.reason: The commander and several outlets exist to sacrifice mixed permanents as the repeating action.

tags.name: graveyard
tags.reason: Dredge, reanimation, retrace, and land-from-grave are how the pit keeps paying.

tags.name: lands
tags.reason: Land offerings, Loam, Ramunap, Titania, and fetch-sac lands are a major axis.

tags.name: aristocrats
tags.reason: Death payoffs exist (Fecundity, Disciple, Jarad) but mixed types matter more than creature tokens.

tags.name: artifacts
tags.reason: Cheap artifacts and artifact lands are the flint half of the three-type rite.

tags.name: midrange
tags.reason: The deck develops a board, trades, then converts with a visible engine rather than combo.

tags.name: ramp
tags.reason: Dorks, auras, Lore/Visits, Harrow, and Bauble support a turn-three commander.

tags.name: reanimator
tags.reason: Animate Dead, Reanimate, Victimize, Living Death, and Witness return the pit.

tags.name: lifegain
tags.reason: Baba gains 3 on a hit and Zuran Orb gains life; not a lifegain win.

tags.name: tokens
tags.reason: Titania elementals and Night Soil Saprolings show up, without token doublers.
